newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: WOODCOMMERZ SAYS TO ISSUE CZK 1.0 BLN ONE-YR CP.
newsitem.headline: WOODCOMMERZ SAYS TO ISSUE CZK 1.0 BLN ONE-YR CP.

text.p: WoodCommerz a.s. on Monday said it would issue one billion crowns (35.9 million) worth of one-year multi-currency commercial paper, guaranteed by the Prague branch of Commerzbank AG .
WoodCommerz said in a statement that the paper would first be issued in Hungarian forints, Slovak crowns, Polish zloty, and Ukranian hryvnias and Czech crowns.

The statement said WoodCommerz will initially assume responsibility for the administrative functions related to the programme, but may, at its discretion, appoint one or more agents "for the purposes of the programme."
It said the paper will be promissory notes in definitive form, issued on a fully-discounted basis.

"The issuer has represented that the notes will rank pari pasu with all other unsecured and unsubordinated indebtedness of the issuer (other than indebtedness preferred soley by mandatory provisions of law)," the statement said.
"The programme will be governed by, and construed in accordance with Czech law. The guarantee will be governed by and construed in accordance with English law," it added.
